pageDescription: Manage your profile, sign-in security, permissions, appearance, and account access.

profileName.description: Keep your account name up to date.

changePassword.placeholderKeepCurrent: Leave blank to keep your current password
changePassword.placeholderAddPassword: Add a password so you can also sign in without Google
changePassword.confirmCurrentRequired: Enter your current password to set a new one
changePassword.updatedButSessionsNotRevokedToast: Password updated, but we couldn't sign out your other sessions. Try Manage Sessions.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Add passkeys for quick sign-in. Give each one a label so you can recognize it; labels are chosen by you, not detected from the device. Password and Google sign-in remain available as recovery options. Adding or removing a passkey asks you to confirm it's you, then stays unlocked for 15 minutes.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser or device does not support passkeys.
passkeys.removeDescription: Remove {{name}} from this account? It can no longer be used to sign in.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.description: Confirm your identity to manage passkeys. You won't be asked again for 15 minutes.
stepUp.confirmedToast: Identity confirmed. You can now add or remove passkeys.

passkeys.selectModeHint: Click anywhere in a row to select it, instead of only its checkbox

bulkDialog.title: Remove {{count}} passkeys
bulkDialog.description: Remove the selected {{count}} passkeys? They can no longer be used to sign in.

removeAllDialog.title: Remove all passkeys
removeAllDialog.description: Remove every passkey from this account? None of them can be used to sign in afterwards. Password and Google sign-in are not affected.

accountStatus.hasPasswordDescription: You can sign in with your email and password. Google sign-in also works when linked, and any passkeys you've added remain available.
accountStatus.noPasswordDescription: This account has no password. Google sign-in and any passkeys you've added remain available. Set a password below to add email/password sign-in.
accountStatus.failedLoadEffectivePermissions: Failed to load your effective permissions
accountStatus.failedLoadDirectPermissions: Failed to load your direct permissions

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Pick a custom brand color for your account. It's saved to your account and applies to buttons, links, and your logo everywhere you sign in.
appearance.contrastWarning: This color may be hard to read on buttons and links. Consider a darker shade for better contrast.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Deleting your account deactivates it immediately and signs you out everywhere. It stays recoverable by someone with the required account-management permission for a short grace period, after which it's permanently and irreversibly removed.
deleteAccount.oauthOnlyDescription: Deleting your account requires confirming by email. Once you confirm, it deactivates immediately and signs you out everywhere. It stays recoverable by someone with the required account-management permission for a short grace period, after which it's permanently and irreversibly removed.
deleteAccount.currentPasswordRequired: Enter your current password to delete your account
deleteAccount.confirmDescription: This deactivates your account and signs you out everywhere right away. It can still be recovered by someone with the required account-management permission during the grace period, but after that it's permanently deleted and cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.oauthOnlyConfirmDescription: We'll email you a confirmation link. Your account is not deleted until you click it. Clicking the link deactivates your account and signs you out everywhere right away. Someone with the required account-management permission can recover it during the grace period. After that, it is permanently deleted and cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.confirmationEmailSent: Check your email for a link to confirm deleting your account. The link will expire after a while, so confirm soon if you want to proceed.

confirmDeletePage.heading: Delete your account
confirmDeletePage.subtitle: Confirm you want to permanently delete this account.
confirmDeletePage.warnDeactivatedSub: You're signed out of every device immediately.
confirmDeletePage.warnDeletedSub: Everything is permanently removed once the grace period ends.
confirmDeletePage.warnChangedMindSub: It can be restored within 30 days by anyone with access to do so.
confirmDeletePage.noTokenHint: Open the link from your email to confirm.
confirmDeletePage.linkExpiredDescription: Delete confirmation links are only valid for a short time. Go to Account Settings to start again.
